job.meaning: «Табло лифта»: чёрный #0E0E10, янтарный LED #FFB000, стальной серый #3A3D42, белый; ведущая ~28, короткие тёмные волосы
job.prompt: Create a complete design system board (brand style guide sheet) for a series of VERTICAL 9:16 Instagram Reels of the brand «ИИАВАТАР» (AI video presenters). Use the attached image ONLY as an example of the board FORMAT (blocks and level of detail) — do NOT reuse its colours, fonts or look. The Reels tells a story: tenants of a skyscraper hated the slow elevators; fixing them would cost millions and a year; it was solved in one day by hanging MIRRORS next to the elevators. Blocks: hero with title «ИИАВАТАР · Reels», colour palette with HEX codes, typography, HOOK headline style (huge headline «ЛИФТ, КОТОРЫЙ ВСЕ НЕНАВИДЕЛИ», one word highlighted), SUBTITLES style (large bold words in the lower third, current word highlighted), an INFOGRAPHIC card «Ускорить лифты: миллионы · 1 год» with a STAMP «РЕШИЛИ ЗА 1 ДЕНЬ», an ILLUSTRATION example (people waiting at elevators, looking at themselves in a big mirror), END CARD «Напишите «ЛИФТ» в директ», and a block «РАСКЛАДКИ 9:16» with 4 phone-shaped frames: (1) presenter full frame + hook headline, (2) presenter in the lower half + illustration card above, (3) presenter in a round frame + three chips «Обучение / Реклама / Блог», (4) full-screen typography «КАК? — В КОНЦЕ» without presenter. In every phone frame keep all text away from the top 13% and the bottom 22% of the frame (Instagram interface zones). Presenter on the board: a NEW confident WOMAN, likeable storyteller (not a fashion model), waist-up, her clothes in the palette colours, a backdrop in the palette colours. The SAME woman appears in all frames. All text in Russian, short, correctly spelled. Mood: modern, urban, techy; the whole look is inspired by an ELEVATOR FLOOR INDICATOR: amber dot-matrix LED digits and arrows ▲▼, brushed steel panels, round elevator buttons. Palette: near-black #0E0E10 background, amber LED #FFB000 highlights and glowing dot-matrix numbers, brushed steel grey #3A3D42 cards, white text. Typography: a bold condensed grotesk for headlines (like «Oswald» or «Bebas Neue»-style Cyrillic) + a dot-matrix/LED style for numbers, body «Inter». The woman is about 28, short dark pixie haircut, wears a black turtleneck with an amber detail.
